environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance in a public subnet with a Network Load Balancer (NLB, Layer 4) forwarding TCP traffic on port 443 directly to the instance on port 8080. Security group allows inbound from 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443. No application-layer inspection. The X-Internal-Token check is satisfied by any 16+ character string passed by the caller.

config.tls_termination: at instance level via nginx proxy_pass
